image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, showing the broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two stalked eyes protrude from the front margin. The large chelipeds (claws) are visible in the foreground, appearing robust with serrated inner edges and dark tips. Several walking legs extend laterally from beneath the carapace. The texture appears hard, calcified, and slightly glossy.

The complex mouthparts (maxillipeds) located between the claws and below the eyes appear somewhat fused and indistinct. While realistic crab anatomy is complex, AI often struggles here, resulting in a 'melted' or overly simplified geometric structure rather than distinct biological segments.
